snippet.title: Fallout 76 - The Slasher Animation - Tokyo Game Show
snippet.description:
Look out, Vault Boy! Don't you know THE SLASHER is on the loose? 

Available now as a free update for all Fallout 76 players, follow the trail of clues (and bodies) behind a series of gruesome crimes committed by a knife-wielding (definitely not pint-sized) maniac! Will you help Appalachia sleep soundly at night...or will your posse be next to fall prey to The Slasher? 

Be sure to get the latest news, community events, info on latest Season of in-game rewards and more for Fallout 76 by visiting fallout.com. 

https://www.xbox.com/games/store/fallout-76/bs6wj2l56b10


ESRB RATING: Mature with Blood and Gore, Drug Reference, Intense Violence, Strong Language, Suggestive Themes, and Use of Alcohol.
